chief_complaint: Hypertension and chronic pain with multiple cardiometabolic and psychosocial comorbidities
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 39‑year‑old male with a long‑standing history of essential hypertension (diagnosed 2007) that remains uncontrolled (BP 136/93, stage 2). Over the past decade he has developed obesity (BMI ≥ 30, onset 2018), obstructive sleep apnea (2017), pre‑diabetes (A1c 6.1 %, 2007), chronic intractable migraine (since 1993) and chronic widespread pain (since 1994). He also has anemia of unclear etiology and a history of dependent drug abuse with two resolved overdoses (2017, 2018). Socially, he experiences housing instability, limited education, social isolation, and ongoing stress. He is currently employed full‑time but has had minimal outpatient engagement; the last recorded encounter was in October 2018. Laboratory monitoring (lipids, renal function, BMI) is missing, and his medication list contains only lisinopril, suggesting substantial under‑treatment of his comorbid conditions.
past_medical_history: Resolved conditions include two overdose events (2017, 2018), a medication review due (resolved 2018), prior part‑time employment (resolved 2017), a resolved episode of stress (resolved 2017), and a prior period of full‑time employment that ended in 2016.
social_determinants: Housing unsatisfactory, only primary school education, limited social contact and social isolation, involvement in high‑risk activities, chronic stress, and current full‑time employment with limited outpatient access.
risk_factor_summary: Blood pressure 136/93 mmHg (stage 2 hypertension); A1c 6.1 % (prediabetes); BMI not recorded (obesity documented); no lipid panel or eGFR values available; Charlson comorbidity index 1; clinical complexity moderate. Comorbidity flags: hypertension and anemia. Organ systems at elevated risk: cardiovascular (hypertension, obesity, prediabetes), metabolic (prediabetes, possible dyslipidemia), renal (possible CKD, anemia), respiratory/sleep (obstructive sleep apnea), neurologic (chronic migraine), musculoskeletal (chronic pain), psychiatric/substance use (drug dependence, stress), dental (impacted molars), and social determinants influencing overall health.

clinical_impression: A middle‑aged male with high‑risk cardiometabolic disease (uncontrolled hypertension, obesity, prediabetes) compounded by obstructive sleep apnea, chronic migraine, and pervasive chronic pain. Substance dependence, anemia, and extensive psychosocial stressors (unstable housing, low education, social isolation) further increase morbidity and impede effective management. Laboratory monitoring and therapeutic interventions appear markedly incomplete, suggesting substantial gaps in care continuity.
